description.en: Plays a named motion/animation on a character handle.
Name of the motion to play.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Play a named standing motion on a character
CMND_SET_MOTION(hTenmaL, "\x0097\x00a7\x0082\x00bf01");
